scripts.pw:ui:xvfb: PW_XDG_OPEN=0 PW_DISABLE_GPU=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 HEADLESS=false xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x720x24' playwright test --ui --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.pw:headless: PW_XDG_OPEN=0 PW_DISABLE_GPU=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 HEADLESS=true playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --reporter=html
scripts.pw:diag: node -e "console.log(process.versions);" && npx playwright --version && env | sort | grep -E "^PW_|^PLAYWRIGHT|^HEADLESS|^DISPLAY|^XDG|^CI|^NODE_ENV" || true && PW_XDG_OPEN=0 PW_DISABLE_GPU=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 HEADLESS=true xvfb-run -a playwright test -c ./playwright.config.ts -g smoke --reporter=list
scripts.postinstall: playwright install --with-deps || npx playwright install --with-deps || true
